race.comment: CALL ME JACK (8) made it two wins from the last four runs at this circuit and distance when he scored by 4.4 metres at the latest appearance. The driver has some work to do from this wide starting position but he is a big chance again with even luck. CHIEF RUNNINGCLOUD (6) came from this barrier when he finished second to CALL ME JACK last week. Starts inside that rival this time. Expect him to pose a serious challenge. LOTUS LOUISE (9) draws wide but hasn't been too far away of late and strikes at 50 per cent at this circuit and distance. ORIA (4) showed pleasing improvement last time out when third to CALL ME JACK. Go well again.
